newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's Anwar announces minor cabinet reshuffle.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Anwar announces minor cabinet reshuffle.

text.p: Malaysia's acting Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim announced a minor cabinet reshuffle on Wednesday, naming a new domestic trade and consumer affairs minister.
Deputy Home Minister Megat Junid Megat Ayob has been given the domestic trade portfolio, left vacant after Abu Hassan resigned to become chief minister-designate of the central state of Selangor.
Deputy Housing Minister Tajol Rosli Ghazali takes the deputy home minister's portfolio and parliamentary secretary Azmi Khalid takes Tajol's place as the new deputy housing minister, Anwar said.
Anwar made the announcement instead of Mahathir, who left for Europe more than a week ago for a two-month leave, mixing holidays and official business.
